Gettysburg, Pennsylvania  ·  26 June – 14 July 1863

Battle Theatre

Fly over the ground, then move through time: the approach, the three days, the retreat. Every mark says how well the record supports it, and where the sources disagree you choose which account to follow.

Return to the map

Ground
Modern terrain: 2022 aerial photograph and 3D Elevation Program elevation. Not the 1863 landscape.
Figures
Units, arrival windows and strengths come from the plan's order of battle and ledger. A unit is drawn only where the record gives it a road and a place; the rest are marked open gap, and anything filled in is marked plausible-procedural.
Time
Local mean time at Gettysburg, with the sun and moon computed for each minute. Night is dimmed, never black.
